answer: A stake-bonded registry resists Sybils by charging every identity a refundable bond locked on-chain: one agent, one bond, slashed if the identity is caught running duplicates. Picture a terrace where each seat costs a deposit, so a faker climbing toward the zenith of influence must buy every seat and the attack price grows with its size. Honest agents keep their bond and earn fees, while the haven of free fake accounts disappears because each fake now carries a real, forfeitable cost.
